title: Backups: restore your work and prove independence
goal: Dump a DT, restore only into a new base and compare two requests before and after changing the copy.

prerequisites.text: 1c-enterprise.a 5; A1–A2: separate infobase, catalogs, references and documents; synthetic data only.

sections.title: From a familiar situation to a checkable question
paragraphs: A DT file exists, but will your work open from it? Restore into a new empty infobase, then change only the copy. Two results at two distinct paths establish more than two attractive list names.

sections.title: Where to act
paragraphs: The worked example uses its own 30/45=75 set. New independent work continues different own 40/25=65 from A5. Do not compare them as one database. Run permission, restoration and upgrade exercises only in a new isolated copy; preserve the original, DT/CFand previous work. Nexus stores the lesson and your note; it does not change external1Croles or data.

sections.title: A backup contains state
paragraphs: A configuration export describes the solution but is not a full copy of customer documents. An infobase dump preserves data with configuration in its supported format. Copying an open file directory can be inconsistent. Choose a supported method and ensure the required absence of active writes.

Create own customer/service Контроль A6 and two requests of 30 and 45 minutes. Record actual codes, numbers, dates, statuses and the 75-minute control. Retain earlier work; the entire-base total may exceed 75. CF represents configuration; a DT is used to transfer infobase state including data.

sections.title: Reason before acting
paragraphs: Compare the same own set rather than all earlier work.
Identify the infobase, list and particular record separately. A command, visible text and saved state are different things.

sections.title: How to carry out the worked example
paragraphs: Follow the route in your prepared own copy. This is the worked example; the new task below uses different data. Compare each expectation with your actual reread.
Step 1. Save own Контроль A6 customer/service and two 30/45 requests with Новая. Record actual keys and 75, retaining older records. Expected: Two own requests reread; control 75.
Step 2. Choose a new DT in your study folder, finish the dump and record path/time/versions. Keep the earlier archive. Expected: New DT created successfully.
Step 3. Choose no configuration, a new teaching name and a new empty directory. Compare its path with the source before opening target Designer. Expected: A separate empty base is identified.
Step 4. Recheck empty-target name/path, choose your DT and confirm replacement of only that target. Wait for completion and open its Enterprise. Expected: Separate restored base opens.

Step 5. Reread both requests and 75. In the copy change first 30 → 45, save and reread 90. Close it, open the original path and verify 30/45=75. Expected: Copy 90, source 75; keys/other fields retained.

sections.title: A file is not a verified restore
paragraphs: Creating a backup file does not prove usability. Restore it into a fresh empty directory, open it and reconcile identities, count, totals and configuration version. File size or extension alone cannot detect the wrong source or a logically incomplete copy.

Close Enterprise and use Designer’s normal infobase dump into a new DT. Record path, time and versions. Copying an actively modified 1CD is not a substitute for this checked route. File existence alone does not establish recovery: opening a separate restored target is required.

sections.title: Predict the result
paragraphs: Two infobases have different list names but the same path. Is that a verified backup?

reveal.title: Check the reasoning
paragraphs: No. They may be two entries pointing to one instance. Compare full paths before changing anything. Restore only into a new empty target, open it and compare saved keys and values.

sections.title: The source is never the target
paragraphs: Record source and fresh destination paths before the operation. If the destination exists, choose another; never erase it automatically. After restore, change the copy to 90 minutes and reread the 75-minute source. This proves independent working instances rather than two shortcuts to one infobase.

Create a new empty infobase without configuration using a new name and directory. Restore replaces the selected target’s contents, so verify its actual path and absence of work first. Never test a dangerous overwrite on your only source; stop such a case before execution.

sections.title: Check the explanation’s boundary
paragraphs: Use the second worked case to identify the unsafe or unproved condition. Never perform destructive restoration over existing work.
Use DT and verify the restored application records.

sections.title: Rejection also needs a protocol
paragraphs: A damaged or unsuitable file should produce explicit rejection. Do not repair the only backup in place or test it by overwriting work. Preserve a file copy, a safe error classification and unchanged source. A recovery plan also identifies storage, acceptable loss of recent changes and responsibility for verification.

Verify both restored requests and 75, then change only the first copy request from 30 to 45. Its set becomes 90; the source must retain 30/45 and 75. Two list entries pointing to one directory are not independent copies. If verification fails, retain the DT and both states for diagnosis rather than overwrite the only archive.

sections.title: A new independent task
paragraphs: Use your two 40/25 requests from A5 and record their numbers, all fields and 65 control. Save a newDT, restore it only into a new empty infobase in another directory and reread 65. In the copy change the first 40→50, save and reopen: the pair totals 75. Separately open the original: it must retain 40/25=65. Preserve the other 55/40+15 request, A4 note and other records.
Record a prediction first. After your own attempt reveal the reference and compare the selected record as well as its number.

No working users were used; the complete manual window sequence was not checked. An author capture does not establish completion of your task.
